customers(customer_id PK, first_name, last_name, region, segment)
orders(order_id PK, customer_id FK, total_amount, status, order_date)

order_items(item_id PK, order_id FK, product_id FK, quantity)

<question>
Show customer first name and order amount for all orders.
</question>

<critique>
Flawed SQL: SELECT c.first_name, o.total_amount FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.order_id;
Issue: Semantic Flaw: Incorrect join predicate. Joining customer_id with order_id causes Cartesian corruption; should join on o.customer_id.
</critique>
response:
<sql>
SELECT c.first_name, o.total_amount FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;
</sql>
